thread:
emily_sales: Kicking off — FinServe POC needs clarity on egress cost split for EU-only geofence + BYOK KMS. They want per-tenant billing and full subproc disclosure before Monday demo. @nate_se can you take the tech lead?

nate_se: Yep. Quick Q: are they on Hosted or Dedicated for the POC?

emily_sales: Hosted, but they want a temporary tenant pin to eu-west and BYOK for keys. They expect egress billed to them, not amortized. Also asked for subproc list and SOC2 certs.

nate_se: For Hosted: we can pin tenant traffic to eu cluster and mark routing policy as strict to avoid fallthrough. BUT note: some infra (CDN/NAT) are still our subprocs in EU — must disclose. Billing: we currently treat geofence-enabled egress as billable to the tenant if configured. For POC we can provide an estimate vs final meter.

maria_ops: We can add per-tenant metering via route tags but need an engineering hook (2-3 business days). For immediate POC we can do manual metering and invoice separately. KMS: Hosted supports envelope keys with cloud KMS; full customer-managed HSM on Hosted is not available today.

emily_sales: So communicate to customer: Hosted BYOK = envelope + cloud KMS tie-in, not on-prem HSM. Is that right @rachel_legal?

rachel_legal: Correct — BYOK in Hosted is limited. We can offer BYOK with cloud KMS key material under customer control for the project, but it is not the same as Dedicated with HSM attestation. If they require HSM-backed keys with attestation, recommend Dedicated or Private. Also will need DPA addendum for BYOK and confirm subproc attestations.

jack_sre: Routing note: default fallback policy is 'preferred' which allows regional failover. For strict residency we set `residency_policy: strict` which will cause requests to fail instead of falling back. This protects residency but raises error risk under load. Example config snippet we use:
```
residency_policy: strict
tenant_pin: eu-west-1
egress_billing: customer
```

nate_se: Customer asked for the list of EU subprocs (esp. CDN and telemetry). @maria_ops do we have the up-to-date list and data center regions?

maria_ops: Current EU subproc list: cloud-provider-eu (compute + network), cdn-eu (edge caching), metrics-eu (observability sink), auth-eu (idp). I'll attach the cert bundle to the deal room. We recently switched metrics sink to metrics-eu cluster — won't cross-border. For the POC we can disable CDN caching to reduce third-country egress.

emily_sales: They also want a rough delta on pricing for strict residency + BYOK on Hosted so they can sign the SOW. Can someone ballpark?

maria_ops: Ballpark estimates for POC: strict residency (no fallthrough) increases operational egress ~20-40% due to less cross-tenant batching and potential duplicated upstream calls. BYOK (Hosted envelope/cloud KMS) add-on ~+$2k/mo for key handling + one-time legal/ops uplift (~$5k) for addendum + subproc validation for POC. All rough until we meter actual traffic.

rachel_legal: I'll prepare the BYOK constraints doc and pull subproc SOC2 + data-center locality certs. Note: we must exclude any subproc located outside EU for the eu-only claim, or mark them as limited exceptions.

nate_se: Action items: @maria_ops produce temporary metering plan and rough cost estimate by Fri EOD. @rachel_legal provide BYOK constraints and attach subproc certs. @jack_sre confirm the strict residency toggle and failure behavior under load. I'll draft the POC SOW language and include the caveats.

emily_sales: :thumbsup: timeline looks good for Monday demo pre-sync. I'll loop in the customer contact after we get the certs.

jack_sre: No infra code changes beyond the tenant-pin flag. Capacity check needed — if they push > 500 tokens/s we may need dedicated burst; please flag early.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4921 for tenant-pin + metering hook. Assigned to maria_ops, jack_sre. ETA 72h.

emily_sales: Thanks everyone — adding the customer to the thread for Monday pre-demo. cc @client_contact
